scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of all infinite parameter claims is given; accompanying finite numerical examples are supplementary and are not presented as proof. No independent mathematical audit or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite complex Hilbert dimension at least two and one fixed diagonalizing basis for the entire continuous family; no extension to arbitrary commuting or nonnormal operator families. Coefficient extreme points need not remain extreme under the possibly noninjective function-valued image. Three-site realization holds after convexification only. Priority relative to classical complex l1 affine-section geometry and scalar normal q numerical-range reductions is not conclusively established.
title: Exact convex geometry and three-site generation of diagonal joint \(q\)-numerical ranges
